title: Marketplace localized trial flow + compliance badges playbook
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures a pragmatic playbook for shipping localized free-trial experiences across cloud marketplaces (AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace) while surfacing compliance/security badges and region-specific legal copy. The goal: reduce back-and-forth between legal/partner ops/engineering and speed up launch of trials without increasing risk.

Context & problem statement:
- We often ship the same marketplace listing across regions but trials and legal footers need regionalized copy, pricing/commitment disclaimers, and specific compliance badges (SOC2, GDPR DPA, FedRAMP in some cases).
- Tickets spin between product, partner-ops, legal, SRE for onboarding artifacts (images, EULA, SLA) delaying listings by 2–6 weeks.
- This playbook provides a checklist + copy templates + technical handoffs to standardize and shorten time-to-live for trial-enabled listings.

Who this is for:
- Partner ops / marketplace PMs doing listing submissions
- GTM and channel marketing writing listing copy
- Legal/compliance for badge verification text
- Engineering / release for packaging trial entitlements and integration hooks

Success metrics (how we know this works):
- Time from draft to published listing <= 10 business days for standard regions
- Number of back-and-forth reviews reduced by 50%
- Trial activation success rate >= 98% (no missing entitlements)

High-level flow (for each marketplace):
1) Prepare listing assets and canonical copy (EN-US) + one localized variant per target region (fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, en-GB, etc.).
2) Compliance badge matrix: map required badges by region/industry (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR DPA, FedRAMP, HIPAA BAAs) and confirm evidence artifact location.
3) Trial entitlement packaging: engineering creates a one-click trial SKU that issues a 14-day scoped API key; QA verifies expired/in-flight behaviors.
4) Legal sign-off on localized footer copy + trial liability language.
5) Submit to marketplace and monitor pre-flight errors; resolve within 48 hours.

Checklist (pre-submission):
- Listing copy: short description (<= 200 chars), long description (<= 2,000 chars), key features bullet list (5–7 bullets), tags/keywords.
- Trial copy artifacts: trial length, trial limitations (tokens, endpoints), auto-charge behavior, opt-in checkbox copy for auto-conversion where applicable.
- Localized legal footer: translation + legal owner contact info per region.
- Pricing/SKU mapping: free-trial SKU (ID), paid SKU mapping, meter/reporting SKU names.
- Compliance badges: badge name, evidence doc link, compliance owner, expiry date of evidence.
- Art assets: logo (PNG 1024x1024), hero image (1920x600), screenshots, marketing slide deck (PDF).
- Technical artifacts: trial entitlement API spec, sample provisioning script, billing webhook endpoint and test token.
- EULA / Data Processing Addendum: latest signed copy attached or link to contract repo.
- Support/SLA references: support hours, escalation playbook link, public SLA doc link.

Localized trial copy templates (examples):
- Short (EN-US): "Get started with Redwood Inference — 14 days free trial, no credit card required. Fast, production-ready LLM inference — optimized for latency and cost."
- Long (EN-US): "Start a free 14-day trial of Redwood Inference. Deploy hosted or dedicated inference, test throughput and latency under real workloads, and evaluate cost-optimization suggestions. No credit card required; trial includes 100k inference tokens and basic support. After trial, choose pay-as-you-go or dedicated committed capacity."
- FR short (fr-FR) (placeholder, legal to verify): "Commencez un essai gratuit de 14 jours de Redwood Inference — aucune carte bancaire requise."
- Auto-conversion checkbox copy (regions that support): "I agree to be charged automatically at the end of the trial under the selected plan. See Terms."

Compliance badge mapping (example):
- SOC2: evidence in /compliance/soc2/2024-report.pdf — owner: Priya Nair — verification: badge approved in marketplace console.
- GDPR DPA: link to DPA template + signature process — owner: Legal — ensure localized DPA reference in EU listings.
- FedRAMP: only required for listings that target US federal customers — confirm FedRAMP LOW/MODERATE status — owner: Security.

Engineering handoff (what to deliver):
- Trial SKU definition file (CSV): sku_id, region, trial_duration_days, token_quota, feature_toggles.
- Provisioning endpoint: POST /marketplace/trial-provision {sku_id, customer_email, region} returns {trial_token, expires_at}.
- Billing webhook sample: we will send invoice events to /webhooks/marketplace/billing; provide shared secret in vault.
- QA checklist for entitlement: happy path, race conditions, expiration revocation, token reuse prevention.

Marketplace-specific notes (short):
- AWS: accepts custom metadata in AMI/listing tags; confirm ML AMI naming conventions for dedicated listings. AWS requires a distinct AWS Marketplace product code for trials in some flows.
- Azure: supports trial offers as separate SKUs with offer IDs; localized Marketplace listing pages often prefer expanded feature lists.
- GCP: trial offers sometimes handled via marketplace partner onboarding; confirm test project quotas.

Launch timeline (example sprint):
- Day 0–2: Draft canonical copy + primary art assets.
- Day 3–5: Engineering implements trial SKU and provisioning endpoint; basic QA.
- Day 6–7: Legal review localized footers + compliance badge verification.
- Day 8: Submit to marketplace.
- Day 9–10: Address marketplace feedback and publish.

Stakeholders & approvers:
- Listing PM / Owner: Lena Park (owner of this doc).
- Legal sign-off: Priya Nair.
- Compliance owner: Samir Khan.
- Engineering lead: Diego Morales.
- Marketing/creative: Evelyn Zhou.

Common pitfalls & mitigations:
- Pitfall: Submitting EN-only legal copy for region-specific compliance. Mitigation: Maintain per-region legal checklist and require legal signoff for each non-EN submit.
- Pitfall: Missing billing webhook or mismatch in SKU IDs between listing and backend. Mitigation: pre-flight integration smoke test using staging marketplace sandbox.
- Pitfall: Auto-conversion language not allowed in market region. Mitigation: default to opt-in manual conversion and maintain opt-in strings per region.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Trial length: should we run 7-day vs 14-day by default per region? (Product to decide based on churn/activation metrics)
- Auto-conversion support: which regions allow it? Need a legal table.
- Badge propagation: who maintains the evidence docs and expiry refresh cadence?

Action items (next steps):
- Product: finalize trial default (7 vs 14 days) and token quota by Monday; owner: Lena Park.
- Engineering: create trial SKU CSV and staging provisioning endpoint; owner: Diego Morales; due in 4 business days.
- Legal: provide translated legal footers for priority EU/UK/JP markets; owner: Priya Nair; due in 6 business days.
- Marketing: finalize hero asset variations (5 variants for A/B); owner: Evelyn Zhou; due in 5 business days.

Notes to self / informal bits:
- Keep copy tight on mobile view — marketplace pages trim long descriptions; lead with performance & cost benefits.
- When in doubt, include a short troubleshooting FAQ in the listing that maps to our public docs.
- Cross-check that the DPA link works from each localized page (sometimes CDN redirects break regioned links).

Draft change log:
- 2024-11-12: Initial draft with goals and checklist — Lena Park.
- 2024-12-04: Added engineering handoff section and trial SKU template notes — Diego Morales.
- 2025-01-08: Incorporated legal feedback on localized footer wording; converted open questions to action items — Priya Nair.

Appendix: quick copy snippets for bullets (pick 3–5 in listing):
- "Low-latency LLM inference optimized for production workloads."
- "Scale from prototyping to dedicated capacity without re-architecting."
- "Smart batching & KV caching to reduce token costs up to 3x."
- "Audit-ready: SOC2 & ISO27001 evidence available on request."

If you see missing items or have region-specific constraints, drop notes below or tag me in #marketplace-listings.
